rows.grounds: compound indicating an extent of three thousand; analyzed as fused form
connective particle continuing the preceding claims
compound indicating a duration of three days; analyzed as fused form
object of attraction, referring to the desired person
expresses the prescribed act of attraction
asserts the certainty of the result

items.question: From what extent and within what time is the desired one certainly attracted?
premises: The desired one can be attracted from a distance of three thousand.
The attraction can be accomplished within three days.
The result of this attraction is declared certain.
items.inference: Therefore the desired one is certainly attracted from three thousand within three days.
uncertainties: The unit or measure implied by tri+sahasram is not explicitly specified.
items.plain_english: And one should certainly attract the desired one from three thousand away within three days.
